explanation: Momentum conserved to machine precision through step 7 (momentum_x ~65.0613, momentum_y ~0), then violated at step 8 when bodies 1 and 2 approach to 1.41 distance with high speeds (8.4 and 1.35) and strong softened gravity. Leapfrog substeps (11) insufficient to integrate rapidly changing forces accurately, causing systematic momentum drift (Δ~0.258 vs allowed 0.115). Halving dt eliminates violation, confirming timestep/substep adaptivity insufficient in close high-acceleration encounter.
